article.story: UNCASVILLE, Conn. -- — Brian Moore Jr. scored 20 points to help Norfolk State defeat Grambling 76-70 on Friday night. Moore had 10 rebounds for the Spartans (8-6). Christian Ings finished 6 of 6 from the field to add 13 points. Kuluel Mading finished 4 of 8 from the field to finish with 10 points. Ernest Ross and Louis Hutchinson each scored 15 points for the Tigers (2-9). Kintavious Dozier had 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
